Tess (Mktg): Quick visual ask for next Wed's webinar on inference economics. Need: 3 hero images (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), 2 process diagrams (routing + graceful fallback), a 1-page SDR crib, and a 15-20s animated fallback slide. First pass by Tue AM.

Ryu (Design): Got it. I have Tue morning. Drop exact headline, stat, and micro-copy for diagram callouts.

Maya (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics you can budget for". Stat: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

Tess (Mktg): Figma (view): https://figma.com/redwood/inference-kit — put hero frames in /marketing/hero and diagrams in /marketing/diagrams.

Ryu (Design): Diagram style — swimlane for animation? Also need 3 short callouts (<=7 words).

Maya (PMM): Callouts:
- Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"
- Batched + cache: "batching + KV cache — lower cost"
- Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput"

Noel (Legal): Add exact footnote to any stat: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Then legal can sign off.

Ryu (Design): Plan: PNG placeholders Tue 9:30AM, animated spec Tue 4PM. Will push to Figma and tag @Tess @Maya. MotionBot: add fade+slide motion spec, 18s total, pause 2s on final.

Tess (Mktg): Owners: Ryu (design), Maya (copy), Noel (legal). Thanks — we'll review Wed AM if assets are in. :rocket:
